Name: Wallet Tools - Animal Husbandry Addon
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[b]Wallet Tools for Animal Husbandry[/b] adds support for Animal Husbandry Mod’s [b]Meat Cleaver / Meat Wand[/b] to Wallet Tools.

Once installed, the Meat Cleaver or Meat Wand can be stored in your wallet instead of taking up inventory space. The patch handles the tool like other Wallet Tools entries.

The wallet icon updates dynamically based on Animal Husbandry’s current mode, so it shows the active Meat Cleaver or Meat Wand. As with changing it in Animal Husbandry's mod you will need to restart the game for it to take effect.

For safety, automatic animal use requires [b]Left Shift + click[/b] by default, helping prevent accidental butchering from a normal animal click. This can be adjusted in GMCM.

If you experience issues using the mod report them to me HERE. Digus will not be able to resolve issues related to this mod. I did get the go ahead to post this but he otherwise has nothing to do with the mod. [url=https://y.yarn.co/b7858509-c464-49ef-b921-2b3a3c3f5ac0_text.gif]You can put that blame on me.[/url]

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
